question: What is the consequence of lacking the accomplishment described in the previous verse?
premises: Some are deprived of that accomplishment.
Without it they do not succeed.
This failure persists for thousands of crores of births.
inference: Those deprived of that accomplishment do not succeed even through thousands of crores of births.
plain_english: Deprived of which, they do not succeed even in thousands of crores of births.
